description: The "Major Foreign Holders of Treasury Securities" ranking from U.S. Department of the Treasury's Treasury International Capital (TIC) System, Major Foreign Holders of Treasury Securities table — the figure financial press cites as "<country> holds $X of US Treasuries." Covers the ~20 largest individual foreign holders plus an "All Other" bucket, the grand total, and the foreign-official-sector split (central banks/governments vs. private holders), in USD billions. Pass "country" for one country's recent months; omit it for the full ranking in a given month (default: most recently published). Only the largest ~20 holders are broken out individually — a smaller holder is not in this table even though it may appear in tic_foreign_holdings. Answers "how much Treasury debt does China hold", "who are the top foreign holders of US government debt".

country.description: One of the ~20 individually-broken-out countries, e.g. "Japan", "China". Omit for the full ranking.

limit.description: Ranking mode: how many countries to return (1-25, default 21, i.e. all of them). Country mode: how many recent months of history (1-13, default 13, the full window the table publishes).

month.description: YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recently published month.

name: tic_major_treasury_holders
title: Tic Major Treasury Holders
